title: Your inventory system
for electronics.
hero.summary: Free, open-source and terminal based. Purpose-built for electronics.

headingLines: Inventatory keeps track of your parts,
so you can focus on building.

steps.title: Automated part entry
steps.text: Scan a supported vendor label or import a order BOM - Inventatory will automatically add the parts, their electrical parameters, datasheets and links to your inventory.
steps.mediaCaption: Stock workspace, part created from a label scan

media.alt: Stock workspace with a capacitor created from a DigiKey code scan, showing its parameters, rack location, and links.

steps.title: Know precisely where your parts are
steps.text: Inventatory features simple 3D-Printable racks. The system automatically assings the precise slot each part is stored in, so later it can give the precise location of each part, not just generic 'Drawer 12'.

steps.title: Build a board
steps.text: Import your EDA BOM and Inventatory will automatically create a project, tell you what you have and what you are missing, and show you on which rack and slot each part is stored.

steps.title: Trust your inventory
steps.text: Every inventory change is recorded. You can see what changed, when and revert to a previous state if needed.

scanner.title: Inventatory Scan R1
scanner.summary: A custom, DiY-able hardware scanner that's directly integrated with Inventatory. It can read vendor labels, modify your stock and print labels for new parts automatically.

open.title: Build it yourself
open.text: The firmware, schematics and instructions that are needed to build the scanner are open-source and available for free. You can design and print your own enclosure.

bundle.title: Pre-designed CAD bundle
bundle.text: The 'just works' solution. It includes ready to use .STEP and .3MF files for the enclosure and charging dock for the scanner. Your purchase supports my projects, thank you!
